units.source_text: 源氏大将本来无微不至地照拂藤壶皇后，即使是些些小事，也极关心。

en.t: General Genji had always looked after Empress Fujitsubo with the greatest care, and even the smallest matters deeply concerned him.

units.source_text: 但此次藤壶皇后入宫，他以心情不佳为由，并不前来送她。

en.t: But this time, when Empress Fujitsubo entered the palace, he said he was in poor spirits and did not come to see her off.

units.source_text: 一般的照顾，固然与先前无异，但明白底细的侍女们都悄悄地互相告道：

en.t: The ordinary arrangements for her care were, of course, no different from before, but the ladies-in-waiting who knew the truth quietly told one another:

units.source_text: “源氏大将心情沉闷，郁郁不乐。”

en.t: “General Genji is gloomy at heart and deeply unhappy.”
They felt they had wronged him.
